author: Daniel Rudford
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Sold by Fred Alger Inc.
text:
Fred Alger Management Inc. lowered its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 11.3% in the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 3,912,596 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 497,473 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up approximately 3.0% of Fred Alger Management Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 7th biggest position. Fred Alger Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $724,261,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Hanson McClain Inc. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 3.9% during the fourth quarter. Hanson McClain Inc. now owns 40,069 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,781,000 after purchasing an additional 1,521 shares during the period. Cable Hill Partners LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.5% during the fourth quarter. Cable Hill Partners LLC now owns 13,737 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,377,000 after purchasing an additional 332 shares during the period. D.B. Root & Company LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter valued at approximately $4,290,000. Wagner Wealth Management LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter valued at approximately $2,271,000. Finally, Ackerman Capital Advisors LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter valued at approximately $620,000. 58.58% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Get Apple alerts: In other news, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 on Friday, August 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total transaction of $3,039,817.20. insider now directly owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at $14,683,563.96. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink . Also, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 on Thursday, August 2nd. The shares were sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total value of $4,131,600.00. Following the transaction, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $238,245,202.14. Insiders have sold 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213 over the last 90 days. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
AAPL opened at $217.36 on Tuesday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 23.60, a PEG ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $150.24 and a 12-month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% in the prior year, the company earned $1.67 earnings per share. On average, equities analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current year.
A number of research firms have recently weighed in on AAPL. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Vertical Group began coverage on Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a “sell” rating for the company. UBS Group set a $250.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, October 8th. Finally, Citigroup increased their price objective on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, October 8th. Three sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $221.63.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
